review_scope: Independent read-only deduplication and representation review. No network requests, graph regeneration writes, source edits, live deployment validation, or production publication.
source_manifest_digest_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace; includes both pinned and observed working hashes.

reconstructed_graph.construction: Executed pinned scripts/make-graph.py in a non-main namespace and called build_graph with five pinned Git blobs. main() was never called; no generated file was written.
reconstructed_graph.canonical_json_hash_format: UTF-8 JSON sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace; not the committed file byte hash.

live_space_reference.basis: Root agent reported these observed Space values in task instruction; this reviewer did not query Space or deployment.
live_space_reference.interpretation: Numerically matches reconstruction but does not establish a matching deployed artifact or source revision.

snapshot_differences.interpretation: Committed generated artifacts are not a current projection of the pinned authoritative inputs. Preserve both populations and their hashes; the Canada packet must not silently repair or deploy unrelated drift.

normalization.names: Exact repository Python slug: NFKD, ASCII transliteration by dropping non-ASCII, lowercase, non-alphanumeric runs to hyphen, trim hyphens. Also compare NFKC casefold plus collapsed whitespace.
normalization.domains: Parse hostname, lowercase, remove trailing dot and one leading www., IDNA ASCII conversion. No DNS or redirect resolution, suffix truncation, or presumed registrable-domain equivalence.
normalization.aliases: Only sourced fragment aliases plus the assigned requested name are used; unverified historic domain/name leads are not automatically canonicalized.
normalization.limitations: Matching strings are candidates for identity review, not evidence that two legal entities or people are identical.

schema_limitations.finding: Startup, founder, funding, profile-fact and relationship objects reject additional properties. Rich country claims, aliases, HQ/incorporation separation, precision, conflicts, transaction kinds and event-specific participation are not new accepted fields.
schema_limitations.consequence: Keep the rich ledger staged separately and project only currently accepted fields. Use sourced profile facts or existing note text where honest, without inventing a public structured contract.

schema_limitations.finding: The additive investor-round reference explicitly requires synthetic:true and is an offline proposal, not a public schema or writer.
schema_limitations.consequence: Do not feed real Canada data into it or relabel real data synthetic. Record real participants in the country staging ledger; coordinate any future adapter with current owners.

schema_limitations.finding: Legacy dates require a complete day. Numeric amounts are safe nonnegative integers with a paired three-letter currency. Null is rejected for typed optional fields; absent founded_year is projected as 0 by the generator, and protobuf numeric scalars are not optional.
schema_limitations.consequence: Omit unknown legacy values; retain null, missing status, date precision, amounts that are ranges/bounds and reported currency wording in staging. Never pad unknown dates, invent currency, substitute zero for unknown, or treat generated zero as an observed founding year.

schema_limitations.finding: mergeStartup preserves omitted fields and merges keyed arrays. Source replacement is guarded for existing description/website/founded_year, funding-event inherited fields, and founder profile_url. Explicit resubmission is required where guarded; unchanged source does not prove that new facts share that source.
schema_limitations.consequence: Before any edit, independently check every retained or newly projected claim against its assigned source. Preserve atomic staging sources. Empty arrays do not delete legacy claims; omission does not mean removal. Source URL hashes and record revisions are distinct.

schema_limitations.finding: Founder IDs are person:<name-slug> globally. Same casefold names reuse an entity and later truthy metadata overwrites fields; different names with the same slug fail. Partner-team people are separately firm scoped. Edit safeguards reject unreviewed new shared-founder association or conflicting metadata.
schema_limitations.consequence: Name equality is insufficient to establish identity. Company-scoped candidate review and fresh shared-person checks are required before integration, including all assembled Canada founders.

schema_limitations.finding: Funding IDs must be globally unique; graph copies event JSON but does not validate new field permission. Portfolio supports edges are company relationships, not investment-event participation. Legacy schema has no participant collection.
schema_limitations.consequence: Preserve distinct equity, debt, notes, grants and secondary transactions and each event-specific source. Do not translate portfolio presence or cumulative totals into a named round investment.

schema_limitations.finding: Both committed graphs lack source_revision. Pinned source reconstruction differs in people, programmes, providers, relationships and financing events.
schema_limitations.consequence: Bind dedup to the explicit Git commit and source-byte hashes; do not label committed or reconstructed counts as live deployment counts. Refresh on the integration branch without overwriting other owners changes.

gaps: No live site, external registry, redirect history or DNS was queried in this read-only audit.
